description: This source file defines a minimal API endpoint for creating a new catalog item in the eCommerce application. It includes route configuration, request handling, validation for duplicate items, creating and updating catalog item details, and returning a response with the created item's data.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for creating catalog items, including route registration and request handling logic.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the POST route for creating a catalog item with authorization and response type.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the create catalog item request, performs validation, creates and updates the item, and returns the result.
